name: dual stereo filter and LF-width imaging
goal: Shape a cinematic tone with stereo ladder/NJM-style filters, left/right cutoff offset or per-key spread, linked high-pass for band-pass effects, and low-frequency width so bass stays centered while highs move.

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

inputs.name: stereo_offset
inputs.description: L/R cutoff offset or per-key spread

outputs.name: stereo_filter_patch
outputs.description: Stereo-imaged filtered patch with centered lows

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Choose ladder-style LPF slope from gentle 6 dB to steep 24 dB (four ladder variants) OR NJM 2069-style model for DW/Poly-era character.
Enable stereo filter path. Offset left vs right cutoff, or use automatic per-key spread, for subtle stereo timbre differences (good automation target).
steps.expect: L/R tonal difference audible but not phasey chaos

steps.action: Add dedicated high-pass; optionally link HP to primary cutoff for band-pass style sweeps. Set keyboard tracking and envelope amounts for both LP and HP.
Output section: set pan-spread so successive voices fan across the stereo field; optional random voice position.
Engage low-frequency width / LF-width: narrow pan of content below ~middle C so bass stays mono-centered while upper spectrum keeps stereo motion.
Optional vintage/voice-offset knob for slight per-voice drift of tune, mixer, filter, envelopes — keep near 0 for clean cinematic pads.

verification: Stereo offset creates subtle L/R difference
HP+LP link yields band-pass when intended
